description: The prior continuous-Mission run exposed a reward and observability mismatch rather than a left/right sampling imbalance: complete-stage training was balanced by direction, but only six Task-target entries occurred in 110 episodes, and the rejected degraded-right Policy ended upright yet 3.1 cm below the authored height threshold. Replace part of the independent posture shaping with a smooth geometric conjunction of the Task-authored height, tilt, linear-speed, and angular-speed targets, retain sparse actor-causal target entry, and publish every stage-by-Scenario episode outcome so PPO cannot receive a high local recovery return while silently missing one physical target dimension or the downstream Mission.
